title: C1c: 80-case replication of the settled-window paired-contrast decoder gate
hypothesis: The frozen capsule-frame/Jacobian decoder produces sign-correct local fingertip motion during settled, pen-following pulses without reducing retention beyond the fixed margin.

prediction.against: neutral-hold cell on the same 80-case seed-4724 manifest
prediction.rationale: As in R-095, zero-request hold minus neutral timeout rate must be >= -0.10; this engineering retention prediction is not a success-improvement claim. Qualification additionally requires Jacobian audit median < 0.15, at least 20 eligible pairs in every one of 15 contrasts, pooled paired sign agreement >= 0.80, and pooled median paired gain in [0.3, 1.5]. The gate verdict decides: pass qualifies this exact frozen decoder for R-094 re-triage; fail or inconclusive leaves R-094 deferred and ends the contact branch under this direction.

protocol.command: gpu run bash -lc 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study contact_settled_gate_80'
code_changes: scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: add contact_settled_gate_80 as a second registry name for the existing lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/contact_settled_gate.py implementation; do not change decoder logic.

config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml: add the 80-case Stage-3 study, copying R-095's frozen block byte for byte and verifying frozen_sha256 7219ec6d5075b4457a6642cb0199de17fdd9bea423a95b0eb17d20d885ede250. Preserve decoder, controller, windows 150-180, thresholds, and eligibility; no calibration or constant changes.

config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_contact_settled_gate_80_s4724.yaml: freeze 80 fresh Stage-3 cases before evaluation. Run 32 whole-manifest cells: neutral hold, zero-request hold, and 5 fingertips x 3 axes x 2 signs at 0.03 m/s. Score positive-minus-negative motion contrasts per paired case using unchanged eligibility. One pre-declared replication, no retries, and no concurrent protocol on the box.

falsified_by: Hold-minus-neutral timeout rate < -0.10 refutes the retention prediction; Jacobian audit median >= 0.15, pooled paired sign agreement < 0.80, or pooled median paired gain outside [0.3, 1.5] refutes decoder qualification. Fewer than 20 eligible pairs in any contrast makes qualification inconclusive, not supported. D-066 left coverage unresolved: lf_normal had 16 pairs and th_normal 19, with 29/40 cases alive at step 180. This explicitly repeats the same mechanism with twice the cases, not relaxed criteria or a retry of seed 4722.

approval.note: This unchanged-decoder replication addresses D-066's unresolved coverage rather than reopening a settled mechanism, making it the right next C1 spend. Reusing scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml costs 2,560 simulator episodes and zero LLM calls on unused seed

result.notes: Gate as pre-declared: PASS, with R-095's frozen block unchanged (hash 7219ec6d5075..., verified equal before the run), no calibration, fresh 80-case manifest seed 4724, 32 cells = 2,560 episodes, no retries. Jacobian audit 0.0048 (< 0.15); zero-request hold 0.8375 vs neutral 0.05 timeout rate (+0.79 >= -0.10); all 15 contrasts have at least 31 eligible pairs (lf_normal 31, th_normal 40, the two that were short in R-095; the rest 51-67); pooled paired sign agreement 1.000 over 901 pairs; pooled median paired gain 0.615 (in [0.3, 1.5]). Per contrast the sign agreement is 1.00 everywhere and the median gain 0.38-0.93, lowest along the normal (0.38-0.55); per fingertip 0.49-0.92, thumb 0.54. Unpaired (secondary): 0.997 over 1,870 eligible pairs, gain 0.70. The numbers reproduce R-095's within 0.01-0.07 per contrast. Limits: fingertip points are link origins near an ideal capsule; the pulses were made with the pen at rest in a closed posture (0.001 m/s), so tracking while the pen rolls is untested; gains below 1 mean a request is tracked at roughly 60%; no sustained spin in any cell. No deviation from the protocol.

verdicts.reasoning: The registered prediction holds (hold minus neutral timeout rate +0.79 against -0.10) and, separately, the gate passes every declared check with the frozen block unchanged: Jacobian audit 0.0048, coverage at least 31 pairs in each of the 15 contrasts, paired sign agreement 1.000 over 901 pairs, median paired gain 0.615. It reproduces R-095's per-contrast numbers on a fresh seed, so the earlier shortfall was sample size. The decoder with hash 7219ec6d... is qualified for R-094 and nothing more: it tracks about 60% of a small request with the pen at rest; tracking during rolling, force and contact are untested.
verdicts.next_experiment: Re-triage R-094 with this frozen block and gate summary; ask for eight blocks.

direction: Test two representation changes for cold pen-spin generation on Stage 3, independently, native sustained success primary, final test locked: (M1) LLM-generated modular policies (MODULE_SPEC + named methods + generated composition inside GeneratedPolicy, no role hints) vs monolithic, same prompt otherwise, 24-draw search for both arms; (C1) a no-LLM contact-frame decoder gate (capsule frames, fingertip Jacobians, requested vs observed local motion); (C2, only if C1 passes) LLM contact-frame velocity rules vs direct joint generation at matched budget. No BC, RL, curriculum, or gradient fitting. One protocol at a time on the box.

advisor.reasoning: This unchanged-decoder replication addresses D-066's unresolved coverage rather than reopening a settled mechanism, making it the right next C1 spend. Reusing scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml costs 2,560 simulator episodes and zero LLM calls on unused seed 4724; its weakest point is that eligibility may still fall below 20 pairs in a contrast. The timeout_rate increase prediction (at least -0.10 versus same-manifest neutral hold) is falsified below -0.10; qualification fails at audit median >= 0.15, sign agreement < 0.80, or median gain outside [0.3, 1.5], while insufficient coverage remains inconclusive. Preserve the exact frozen hash and one-shot stopping rule: only a pass permits R-094 re-triage, and this engineering gate establishes no native sustained-success improvement.

implementer.reasoning: Approve. It changes one thing, the number of cases, and nothing I could tune: the frozen block, its hash, the window, the thresholds and the absolute 20-pair minimum are R-095's, there is no calibration, the seed is fresh and the stopping rule is one shot. The risk the advisor names is real (lf_normal lost 13 of 29 live cases to decoder bounds in R-095, so 80 cases should give about 32 pairs there, but that is an extrapolation); if coverage still fails the result is inconclusive and the contact branch stops.
